Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class XpressBeesShipmentStatus

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.XpressBeesShipmentStatus
public final class XpressBeesShipmentStatus extends Object
Maps ExpressBees forward-shipment milestones onto customer-facing tracking. AWB generation is only a label/booking. "Shipped" starts at the first physical scan (pickup / in-transit / out for delivery).
